one_line: Hold the product to the lens, cut to a top-down shot of it in use, end with a comment-for-link ask.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 eye-level selfie: a woman's eyes over a felt-hands board and a box; 0:01 cut to a child's arm placing magnets on a floor board. Voice and text: "מי שמסכים איתי שילדים צריכים ללמוד דרך חוויה"; 0:03 "תעשו מהר לייק".
q1_hook.why: A person speaks to the lens from 0:00, the line is said and written, and a cut at 1.4 s keeps it moving (H4, H6, E1). But the products are not named until 0:08 (H2), and a like request at 0:03 spends the hook on a count ask (C2).

beats.what: Mother's eyes above a felt-hands board and box, cut to a child's arm placing magnets
beats.why: Opinion line with product and child in view

beats.what: She holds up the "חשבון בכיף" 36-card box; "תעשו מהר לייק כדי שאדע שאתם איתי"
beats.why: Early like ask, before any value

beats.what: Sandglass, marker, a fan of maths cards; "משחקים חדשים של חושים מבית פלפוט"
beats.why: Names the retailer and the line

beats.what: Mother and daughter go through cards, mother laughs; child writes answers on yellow and purple cards
beats.why: The one warm moment, then real use

beats.what: Mother shows a wooden hands board, an orange card, a bag of number tiles; "משחק נוסף"
Top-down: child's hands use the felt-hands board, cards and wooden number tiles
beats.why: Shows how the hands help with sums

beats.what: Child unpacks the day and night routine board, places picture magnets, taps the star stickers
beats.why: Third product, a new picture each shot

beats.what: Hands open the magnet bag; board held up by its rope handles; "אני אקפיץ אליכם"

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: A like request at 0:03 ("תעשו מהר לייק"); spoken at the end, comment on the video for a link with a coupon (transcript); caption: "תגיבי והבוטית שלי תשלח לך". No question to answer.
q2_flow.why: A hold-up then a top-down use shot repeats per product, so something new appears every few seconds, and the laugh at 0:11 adds feeling (R3). But three products in 47 s, each with a spoken feature list, is closer to a list than a story (R1), with no payoff at the end (R4). 47 s fits a multi-product demo (R2).

q3_cta.what: Spoken 0:43 to 0:47 (transcript): "אם בא לכם קישור, תגיבו לסרטון, אני אקפיץ לכם יחד עם קופון". On screen 0:44 "אם בא לכם קישור", 0:45 "אני אקפיץ אליכם". Caption: "תגיבי והבוטית שלי תשלח לך". Earlier: "תעשו מהר לייק" at 0:03.
q3_cta.why: A comment-for-link with a coupon delivers a real thing, said, shown and repeated in the caption, after the value (C3, C6), but no keyword is named. The like request at 0:03 adds a second, count-only ask (C1, C2).

q4_shown.what: The mother's face, products held to the lens: felt-hands board, "חשבון בכיף" box, sandglass, cards. A girl of about 7 to 9 writes on cards, lays tiles, fills a routine board; mother and daughter laugh at 0:11. No price; a coupon is only spoken.
q4_shown.why: Products are on screen at 0:00 and in use by 0:01 (S1). The mother says they are trying them at home now ("שאנחנו מתנסים בהם בבית עכשיו", transcript), first-hand vouching (S6). The retailer name is said twice, light (H3). The child's face appears, without her name (S5).

q5_edit.what: 19 shots in 47 s, about 2.5 s each; hard cuts alternating mother to camera and top-down use. Voice wall to wall; subtitles change about every second in 1 to 3 word chunks. No speed changes. Ends on the routine board held up.
q5_edit.why: A cut every 2 to 5 s, first at 1.4 s, fits the advised pace (E1, E2). Voice plus short synced chunks work with sound on or off (E4), though text covers the products throughout (T2). It ends right after the ask, no tail (E8).

q6_topic.what: A mother's home trial of three Palphot learning products: maths cards, felt-hands board, routine board; serves parents seeking learning games and routines, with a coupon.
q6_topic.why: Routines and school maths are real parent concerns, shown in a casual first-person tone (K6). The claims "מלמד את הילד עצמאות, אחריות" (transcript) are strong, not modest (K4). The shared laugh at 0:11 is the only high-arousal moment (K1).

q7_filmed.what: Phone selfie at eye level in a living room, products held to the lens, her face partly covered; top-down floor shots of a child using the products; one seated two-shot of mother and daughter; low window light; handheld.
q7_filmed.why: She speaks to the lens, the home setting looks native (F6, H8). Top-down floor shots show each product in use (F5). Products held close fill the frame (F4). The subtitle band sits across the products and her chest, close to the lower zone (F2).

q8_text.on_screen: White bold word-chunk subtitles with a shadow, no box, centred about 58 to 66% down, over the products, changing about every second: "מי שמסכים איתי" (0:00), "תעשו מהר לייק" (0:03), "קלפים רב פעמיים" (0:11), "לוח התארגנות" (0:30), "תחושה של הצלחה" (0:41), "אם בא לכם קישור" (0:44), "אני אקפיץ אליכם" (0:45). No headline card.
q8_text.caption: "תקשיבו המחירים כל כך הוגנים !". About 42 words: a price-fairness claim with no price, a coupon on the retailer's site, toy stores, a comment-for-link line, last line "זה בשיתוף @palphot". No hashtags.
q8_text.why: Subtitles of nearly all speech let a muted viewer follow, in short chunks (T1, T2), each held about a second (T5). They sit at the edge of the bottom zone (T4). The caption's first line is a price claim, not a keyword, with no hashtags (T7). The partner line is last, with no label (T8).

weak_points: A like request in the first 3 s; three products in 47 s; subtitles over the products; a price-fairness claim with no price shown; strong developmental claims; two different asks; disclosure is the last caption line.
lumebook_takeaway: Hold the book up to the lens first, then a top-down page-turn, chunk subtitles and one comment-for-link ask at the end; skip the like request.
not_verified: Whether the products were gifted or paid (collab co-author, no paid label). The girl's age (estimated). The coupon terms. Music. Whether a subtitle "תגיבו לסרטון" shows between my 1 s samples near 0:44, though it is spoken. No other corrections to the coded file.
